Implemented the timezone overlap app in [src/main.jsx](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.OwP5HW/app/src/main.jsx) and [src/style.css](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.OwP5HW/app/src/style.css). It includes Meeting and Base modes, a searchable city catalog, reference-city promotion, awake-hour settings, DST-aware offsets, localStorage persistence, and separate desktop and mobile grid layouts. The page title and heading are “GPT-6.”

The dev script is configured for port 9104 in [package.json](/private/var/folders/7z/5mtgxwxx4zs9ppgzm942gbmh0000gn/T/workspace.OwP5HW/app/package.json). I couldn’t complete the requested runtime checks: `pnpm install` failed with `SecItemCopyMatching failed -50`, and Portly returned a macOS executable error and hung when I tried to run the build. So the app has **not been build- or browser-verified**.
